id: Aku tahu kamu tuh berbakat! Pertahankan dan Pangkat Pemburumu bakal naik 3! Pastinya kamu menarget lebih tinggi dari ini, kan? Aku menyemangatimu!
name: MST_FRONTIERHUNTER_UNIQUEREWARD_1802_COMMENT
desc: I knew you had it in you! Keep this up and your Hunter Rank will increase by 3! But surely you're aiming higher than this, right? I'm cheering for you!

raw.en: I knew you had it in you! Keep this up and your Hunter Rank will increase by 3! But surely you're aiming higher than this, right? I'm cheering for you!

raw.pt: Eu sabia que você conseguiria! Continue assim e sua Classificação de Caçador aumentará em 3! Mas com certeza você quer mais do que isso, não é? Estou torcendo por você!
raw.th: ข้ารู้ว่าท่านต้องทำได้! ทำให้ได้แบบนี้ต่อไปและอันดับนักล่าของท่านจะเพิ่มขึ้นอีก 3! แต่แน่นอนว่าเป้าหมายของท่านอยู่สูงกว่านี้ใช่ไหมล่ะ? ข้าจะคอยเชียร์ท่านนะ!

id: Hei! Kerjamu bagus! Kalau kamu mempertahankan ini, Pangkat Pemburumu akan naik 2! Tapi berhati-hatilah karena kalau kamu mundur, pangkatmu akan turun 1. Kamu tidak akan membiarkan hal itu terjadi, kan?

desc: Hey there! You're doing great! If you keep this up your Hunter Rank will increase by 2! But be careful because if you fall back it will drop back down to 1. You won't let that happen though, right?
